enum _fw_dist_phase_t

Firmware distribution phases. Use fw_dist_phase_t to ensure the correct frame format.

Values:

enumerator FW_DIST_PHASE_IDLE

No firmware distribution is in progress.

enumerator FW_DIST_PHASE_TRANSFER_ACTIVE

Firmware distribution is in progress.

enumerator FW_DIST_PHASE_TRANSFER_SUCCESS

The Transfer BLOB procedure has completed successfully.

enumerator FW_DIST_PHASE_APPLYING_UPDATE

The Apply Firmware On Target Nodes procedure is being executed.

enumerator FW_DIST_PHASE_COMPLETED

The Distribute Firmware procedure has completed successfully.

enumerator FW_DIST_PHASE_FAILED

The Distribute Firmware procedure has failed.

enumerator FW_DIST_PHASE_CANCELING_UPDATE

The Cancel Firmware Update procedure is being executed.

enumerator FW_DIST_PHASE_TRANSFER_SUSPENDED

The Transfer BLOB procedure is suspended.

enum _fw_upload_phase_t

Firmware upload phases. Use fw_upload_phase_t to ensure the correct frame format.

Values:

enumerator FW_UPLOAD_PHASE_IDLE

No firmware upload is in progress.

enumerator FW_UPLOAD_PHASE_TRANSFER_ACTIVE

The Store Firmware or Store Firmware OOB procedure is being executed.

enumerator FW_UPLOAD_PHASE_TRANSFER_ERR

The Store Firmware procedure or Store Firmware OOB procedure failed.

enumerator FW_UPLOAD_PHASE_TRANSFER_SUCCESS

The Store Firmware procedure or the Store Firmware OOB procedure completed successfully.

enum _fw_dist_status_code_t

Firmware distribution status codes. Use fw_dist_status_code_t to ensure the correct frame format.

Values:

enumerator FW_DIST_STATUS_SUCCESS

The message was processed successfully.

enumerator FW_DIST_STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES

Insufficient resources on the node.

enumerator FW_DIST_STATUS_WRONG_PHASE

The operation cannot be performed while the server is in the current phase.

enumerator FW_DIST_STATUS_INTERNAL_ERR

An internal error occurred on the node.

enumerator FW_DIST_STATUS_FW_NOT_FOUND

The requested firmware image is not stored on the Distributor.

enumerator FW_DIST_STATUS_INVALID_APP_KEY_INDEX

The AppKey identified by the AppKey Index is not known to the node.

enumerator FW_DIST_STATUS_RECEIVERS_LIST_EMPTY

There are no Target nodes in the Distribution Receivers List state.

enumerator FW_DIST_STATUS_BUSY_WITH_DIST

Another firmware image distribution is in progress.

enumerator FW_DIST_STATUS_BUSY_WITH_UPLOAD

Another upload is in progress.

enumerator FW_DIST_STATUS_URI_NOT_SUPPORTED

The URI scheme name indicated by the Update URI is not supported.

enumerator FW_DIST_STATUS_URI_MALFORMED

The format of the Update URI is invalid.

enumerator FW_DIST_STATUS_URI_UNREACHABLE

The URI is unreachable.

enumerator FW_DIST_STATUS_NEW_FW_NOT_AVAILABLE

The Check Firmware OOB procedure did not find any new firmware.

enumerator FW_DIST_STATUS_SUSPEND_FAILED

The suspension of the Distribute Firmware procedure failed.

enum _fw_update_policy_t

Firmware update policies. Use fw_update_policy_t to ensure the correct frame format.

Values:

enumerator FW_UPDATE_POLICY_VERIFY_ONLY

Initiates firmware image application only upon verification.

enumerator FW_UPDATE_POLICY_VERIFY_AND_UPDATE

Verifies and then applies the firmware update automatically.
